title: [GB] GovTalk: migrate SendHttpRequest from DotNet HttpWebRequest to native HttpClient
summary: GovTalk message submission migrated from deprecated DotNet HttpWebRequest to native HttpClient for HTTP communication with HMRC.
key_points: Replaced DotNet HttpWebRequest with native HttpClient and HttpRequestMessage/HttpResponseMessage types
Applied migration to both GovTalk app and obsolete GB Base App copy
Progress dialog now only opens when UI is available
Added two new test cases covering successful POST with XML parsing and non-200 status handling
Protocol behavior preserved: POST, text/xml content type, utf-8 encoding, follow redirects, 100s timeout
